subject: Re: Kickoff: collaborative translation data pipeline
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Gustavo Moreau leads at 50%, Amara Okafor 40% on rater tooling integration, Leilani Nakamura 30% on the data pipeline, Efe Lindqvist 25% on analysis.

On your compression ask: we're scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe from scratch — Gustavo owns the recipe build within his 50%, with Efe supporting — to distill the expensive post-editing teacher setup into a student model we can run continuously. I checked around and nothing in-house covers this, so we're budgeting it as a ground-up build: roughly six engineer-weeks, first trainable version mid-June.

Platform: we need Corpus rater queues for the MQM annotation passes (the 2-3 week privacy SLA applies since raters see source text), and modest titan GPU time for the student training.

Alina
